note: v4 arm A control, median seed

engine.scene_change: not simulated (no phash; sequences are per camera-azimuth)
engine.episode_rule: new episode iff ts - last_alert_frame_ts >= cooldown_s; fresh engine per sequence (R_eff) / per negative run (FP)

cadence.rule: gap excluded if > 3 x sequence median cadence (PROTOCOL_V5 §3)

negative_observation_set.nature: embedded negatives = no-GT-box frames inside pyro-sdis VAL alert sequences (before/after/between smoke), NOT continuous clean footage

anchor.definition: frame recall (IoU>=0.4 greedy, eval_detection.sweep_report) of deployed expB at conf_single=0.30 on pyro-sdis VAL; R_eff = engine-aware recall at 0.30/0.15

figlib_check.diagnostic_note: DIAGNOSTIC from saved per-frame scores (4-dp rounded for YOLO); sensitivity only; not used for selection (FIgLib is banned from tuning/selection, §2)
